verdict.rationale: Amplitude's integrations directory lists CRM and warehouse platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Snowflake and BigQuery, but the descriptions never say whether data flows out to them. The page's framing ('Connect ... to Amplitude') suggests inbound data. A community report says Amplitude doesn't do a good job sending data back to SFDC, which implies outbound sync exists but is weak. missing for 10: explicit docs on event streaming/forwarding to destinations, ad-platform destinations, registrable outbound webhooks, real-time streaming semantics, independent corroboration that outbound sync works well.
